reviews.text: We had such a great experience at broadway animal hospital, everyone was so kind!  We were greeted pleasantly at the front desk by their joyful staff.  My little shitzu was really scared of going to the vet, but the staff gave him treats and handled him with care.  We will definitely be coming back!

I had a wonderful experience with this veterinary clinic. The staff was very friendly, caring, and professional. They treated my kitty with so much patience and kindness and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire visit. You can truly tell they care about their patients. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a compassionate and trustworthy veterinarian!
Karim B.

Love this place! I won't be bringing my cat anywhere else. The staff is friendly and supportive and knowledgeable, and Dr. Dupre is especially awesome. My grumpy senior girl is always given the best attention and care.

The doctors are good but the staff is hurrendous. Twice they have neglected to give the dr the info i provided them. This last time i called at 830 and sent further info at 9. They relayed inaccurate info to the dr. Causing my dog to nearly die and never get a call back. DONT TRUST YOUR PETS WITH THAT STAFF. There is a history of appointment problems. Where time relayed to me was not the time of the appointment. These were just SOME of the abuses we received from the staff. Another thing, when there was a choice to require a deposit or not they always made me pay even though all payments were previously made on time. Not nice people. And they don't care about your pet
Ayelet has been a very caring and attentive vet tech for my aging cat Nestor on his weekly fluid visits. I trust he's in great hands with her and she also helped us economize on these visits.

Dr perry is the best vet and we love him. Very caring and patient. Jay  who is at the front desk allways has a,smile. He helps with any concerns and  I feel. Is an excellent  staff member.  I look forward to seeing him when I bring my pet

Dr. Perry and the team have been attentive to Baba since I've brought him in for his check-ups and most recently a tumor removal. I also deeply appreciate their transparency around costs as taking care of your dog's health can be expensive. I highly recommend Broadway Animal Hosptial.

I can't thank Candice, Gilbert & Dr Kim enough for the kindness & professionalism they extended to me & my Paisley on Friday morning.
I live only a block away from Broadway AH after recently moving to the neighborhood & am not, yet, an established client. However, on Friday morning, it was clear that my 19 year old kitty was in distress at the end of her life & that we would not be able to keep a previously scheduled euthanasia appointment.
Broadway was able to get us in within a couple of hours for an exam & consult to make end of life decisions.
I have worked in vet med & rescue. I was fairly certain I would be sent to a ER clinic. Instead, Paisley & I were treated with compassion and care at our local veterinarian.
I will be establishing my other kitty with Broadway AH for her future care.
Again, thank you for your care on a very sad day.

Shout out to the whole team. Dr. Perry has been so caring and helpful in taking care of furry babies. The front desk staff always have a warm smile and a compassionate understanding — small things make a big difference. Thank you, guys.
My dog was very relaxed and had a better attention possible.

The staff is always kind, compassionate, and helpful, especially with scheduling changes and urgent health issues. I can’t recommend Broadway Animal hospital enough! Thank you kindly to Dr. Dupre, Dr. Perry, Dr. Kim, and the entire staff for everything you do for our fur family!

This place will scam you. They shame you and hand you a huge bill insisting you need to have expensive procedures done for your pet. The most recent experience was being told they couldn’t refill our pets meds because they haven't seen her in a year, which would be reasonable, except they then continued to gaslight and say they haven’t been the ones refilling it at all the past year (a lie, again.) It would have been fine if they could’ve even given us a week refill so we’d have time to schedule and plan to bring our pet in, but instead they decided best practice was to leave an animal without medication that should not be suddenly stopped. I’ve since taken my pet to a new vet, who provided genuine care and didn’t try to overcharge me. Save your time and money, this is not the same quality of care as it was a few years ago.
I had a wonderful time here with my dog! The doctor I saw explained everything very thoroughly. I will definitely be coming back here again!

I’d give 0 stars if I could. As someone whose been coming to this vets office for years now, I requested a prescription refill for gabapentin for my senior dog and they informed me that because she wasn’t seen for the same prescription that she would need to have her bloodwork redone. I can easily give her gabapentin that is prescribed by a medical doctor so this whole back-and-forth bullshit is why I will never go to Broadway animal Hospital again.
It's just wonderful that they have recently instituted their own payment plan option. It makes it so much easier to go.there for unexpected emergency care and treatment.

I had a great experience with Broadway Animal Hospital. My kitty got diagnosed with a mammary tumor and I had an extremely hard choice to make about treatment. Dr. Kim explained everything thoroughly, answered my MANY questions with patience and compassion, and didn't pressure me to pursue any one type of treatment which mattered a lot at a fragile time. It was obvious that they were care driven and not price driven when they suggested that I do testing at the facility I would have surgery at (I was moving out of state) instead of replicating it at multiple vets to save the money. I ended up booking surgery and then cancelling it, and the office was extremely compassionate and communicative despite my back and forth. I am grateful for the support and kindness offered when we needed it most. Also worth noting, the surgical price quoted was far more reasonable than other places I asked around at.
Quin, thank you so much for the support. We're glad you had a great experience with us!
So friendly and helpful!!!  I have a very anxious feral cat who is not easy and they were so wonderfully helpful and understanding.  Always nice customer service and helpful people.

Dr. Dupre and the wonderful nurse who spoke to me in Spanish, thank you. I arrived very sad with my senior dog hoping for a new solution after months of trying different things. I trust 🙏🙏🙏 that this new treatment will work, but thank you for your kindness to our dogs and your kindness to the parents.

For over 15 years I've enjoyed your service. You have new doctors now, and they're all amazing. I've been taking Cabruccino to you for two years now, and you've always provided excellent service. On this last visit, I want to thank Vet Tech Ayelet and Dr. Perry; they were so understanding with my little one, as he's very nervous and shy.

Dr. Dupre was excellent—attentive, communicative, good at explaining. The facility is impressive: clean, modern, in-house labs.

Frankie, the tech, was a different story. During intake, he quoted me $700+ before I could even say why I was there—blood work ($300+), vaccines, visit. When I pushed back on the blood work cost, a cheaper option suddenly appeared that was also more convenient (same-day results). Why wasn’t that offered first?

The pattern continued with medications. I wasn’t told prices upfront. At checkout, two common drugs cost $240 combined. One—gabapentin—I knew was cheaper elsewhere. When I said I’d buy online, Frankie got visibly agitated. Then magically, a cheaper form existed: $120 for tablets vs. $28 for capsules. Why start with the most expensive option?

I decided to buy the gabapentin from them anyway ($30, convenient for same-day pickup). When I told Frankie, he became noticeably upset, saying “I’ll have to change THE ENTIRE SCRIPT NOW” and stormed off. It took him 3 minutes. The condescension when he returned—muttering about me staying past closing (5:43pm, 13 minutes over)—sealed it. I arrived on time, waited for their in-house bloodwork, and was made to feel like a burden for managing my costs. I’m not at the vet hanging out past close for fun.

I’ll be back but I hope by then Frankie has had some training because his approach was a huge source of agitation for me.

This was my first visit with my pet and I was extremely pleased with everything. You can tell all the staff truly loves animals and put the animals first. Everyone was very patient with my pet’s nerves and patient with me, as I had a lot of questions and explanations about my pet. Pet ownership is expensive in general but I thought the prices were reasonable and transparent. Very happy I took a leap of faith to try a new vet! I would recommend other pet owners to try this office.

‘They Broke My Cat’

After years of taking my cats to Broadway Animal Hospital, they just gave me the biggest reason to leave. My current cat Renée had a big lump in her abdomen and her vet, Dr. Sohee Kim performed surgery on Renée to remove it. Renée was put under anesthesia and so after picking her up after surgery on a Thursday, she was groggy. Renée’s discharge paper mentioned in the 1st line that she will be slightly lethargic for up to 24 hrs. Renée was prescribed painkillers, which were started immediately the night after surgery. Renée did wake up and I followed the instructions.Then the next day, Friday, Renée barely ate and had yet to get up and walk. Saturday and Sunday she stopped eating and did not get up to walk.

Monday i brought Renée to Broadway Animal Hospital. Dr. Sohee Kim did an exam and had a full body x-ray(s) done. Dr. Sohee Kim determined it was anemia and that Renée had hip fractures. Anemia needs a transfusion, which they do not handle at Broadway Animal Hospital, so an emergency care vet had to be chosen (Broadway Animal had a sheet with emergency care places) for Renée.

Dr. Sohee Kim inquired if I dropped her or did she fall. The questions were moot because Renée never moved out of carrier during her return home (Thursday-Monday). So what happened at Broadway Animal Hospital before or during surgery?  Now that is the question. If they did anything, no one is talking.

I conclude that Broadway Animal Hospital accidentally caused the hip fractures. Which then caused the Anemia. Blame is a human reaction, like when Dr. Sohee Kim inquired/questioned me about dropping Renée or her falling, they were already putting blame of Renée’s condition on me.

Oh, I just received word that when the emergency vet removed the stitches, they found a new lump near the stitches. So now I wonder if Dr. Sohee Kim removed it all. The big lump came back cancerous. Goodbye Broadway Animal Hospital. Good luck future and current pet parents in your decision to be at Broadway Animal Hospital.
Great care and quick with vaccines.
Amazing staff! They certainly do go above and beyond.

Very Proffessional !
They will take care of your Animal from the minute u walk in till the minute you leave! DOCTOR AND ASSISTANTS AWESOME!
Always pleased with the treatment from the medical staff but the service provided by Gael sets this practice apart as five stars.
The vet and the vet tech listened carefully to everything I said and were good communicators. They were very kind and took good care of my beloved dog.

Great customer service & staff is excellent . My dog princess she loves it there.

I had an outstanding experience at Broadway Animal Hospital in Chicago. From the moment I walked in, the staff provided exceptional customer service with kindness, professionalism, and genuine care. They made both me and my pet feel welcomed and comfortable throughout the visit.

The veterinarians and technicians were incredibly attentive, knowledgeable, and compassionate. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and ensured my pet received the best possible care. Their dedication and patience truly stood out.

What impressed me most was the combination of excellent medical care and a warm, caring environment. It’s clear that the team at Broadway Animal Hospital is passionate about what they do and committed to treating every pet like family.

I highly recommend Broadway Animal Hospital to anyone looking for top-quality veterinary care and outstanding customer service in Chicago. Thank you for the wonderful experience!

Before you book an appointment here, there is something you should know: Broadway Animal Hospital is no longer a neighborhood clinic. It is one of over 300 veterinary practices owned by Heartland Veterinary Partners, a Chicago-based company majority-owned by Gryphon Investors, a San Francisco private equity firm. You will not find this disclosed anywhere on their website or in their office. The name is the same. The location is the same. The staff is the same. That is the point.

When Gryphon invested in Heartland, one of their principals publicly described the business as offering "scalable systems, standardized back office support operations, and a predictable and attractive business model generating strong, cash-based revenue." That is what Broadway Animal Hospital is to its owners. Not a neighborhood clinic. A revenue node in a 300-location private equity portfolio.

People choose neighborhood clinics over corporate chains for a reason. You pay a premium -- in time, in loyalty, in trust -- because you believe you are supporting something local, something that knows your pet, something accountable to the community it serves. At Broadway Animal Hospital, that premium is now being collected by a San Francisco private equity firm. The wellness exam prices reflect it. The pharmacy arrangement reflects it. The billing reflects it. None of it is accidental. It is the model.

You deserve to know who you are actually doing business with before you walk through the door.

Heartland's prescription system is not a collection of unrelated policies. It is a coordinated strategy to eliminate your ability to fill prescriptions anywhere other than their in-house pharmacy. Digital prescriptions go only to their fulfillment platform, not a pharmacy. This ensures you can't transfer the prescription to another provider. The only way to use any other pharmacy is a handwritten paper that must be physically mailed. Prescription numbers -- the basic information you need to transfer a prescription -- are nowhere in their online platform or client communications. They are available if you specifically request them in writing, which ensures that only the most determined clients will ever actually get them. Each piece of this, on its own, might be explained away. Together, they cannot be. Together, they are a deliberate system built to make the friction high enough that you stop trying and buy from their pharmacy instead. Two prescriptions using their service were over $250. Chewy's price was $175.

This would be infuriating at any price point. At $600 for a routine annual wellness exam, it is beyond the pale.

What I find most objectionable is what it reveals about how this corporate ownership model views its clients. Pet owners come to a vet vulnerable. We trust them with animals we love deeply. We follow their guidance because we believe they have our pets' best interests at heart. This system reveals that trust is being treated as a commercial asset -- something to be leveraged by private equity, not honored by a caregiver. That is an abuse of the relationship, and I do not use that phrase lightly.

We are taking our dog's care elsewhere and we are not coming back. If you are considering this clinic, I'd encourage you to first ask whether it is corporate-owned -- and whether that ownership has your pet's interests or their profit margins in mind.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Kimberly! We love caring for your pets!
Compassionate and gentle with my cat. Answers all my questions and I always have a few!

Everyone that helped my SEVERELY stranger aggressive cat today was awesome. She totally hated it, but I think everyone did everything they could to keep everything as calm as it could be. We got gabapentin a few hours before the visit which was unfortunately not enough to quell the crazy at the vet, but did wonders getting her in her carrier at home. She had to be anesthetized to be examined, which was to be expected, but they checked in with me several times and kept me updated with her frequently. They went over everything with me and nothing seemed like a non-essential service. Expensive but she's an absolute bonkers senior old lady with a lot of gusto to put it mildly who hadn't been to the vet in many years mostly because of her behavior but also from bad experiences at other vets that had made me feel like a bad cat parent that was not welcomed back. Someone's gotta love the crazy old ladies and they deserve care too. Poppy hated the experience but I am very thankful!! She's back in her home calm and purring with her mom after being a screaming demon :)

Everytime we visit, the staff is incredibly helpful and receptive to all of my questions. They are so kind and friendly to my pup, and she loves going--I call it her "adventure" when we head out the door, and she hurries as fast as her little legs will take her. Thank you for everything you do to keep her happy and healthy!

Absolutely predatory behavior. I brought my healthy dog in for simple blood work required for a teeth cleaning—a routine procedure for a dog they already saw recently for annual vaccines. Instead of providing the service, they refused to do the blood work unless I agreed to a forced 'senior exam' for an additional $80.

When I pointed out that my dog is perfectly healthy and fully compliant with all Chicago and Cook County vaccination laws, they essentially held his medical care hostage. They would rather turn away a patient and deny service than miss out on an opportunity to price-gouge a loyal client.

It’s clear this clinic prioritizes 'upselling' and corporate quotas over the actual well-being of animals. If you don't want to be pressured into unnecessary exams and hidden fees just to get basic care, stay far away from this place. They are looking for wallets, not patients.

Marco and Dr. Dupre are amazing!!

These folks are the right combination of kind, responsive, and passionate about my small pup. Dr. Perry has been great!

Both Tech Ayelet and Dr. Perry were very kind and knowledgeable. This was my first visit to the hospital, and the staff made me feel welcome right away. I brought my cat in for a routine post-adoption checkup. Ayelet performed a thorough examination and explained everything clearly, breaking down the medical terms into simple English, which I really appreciated.

There was a bit of a wait, about 20–25 minutes, before Dr. Perry came in, as he was handling an emergency case. During the exam, he noticed a hard lump near my cat’s incision area and recommended an X-ray to rule out a hernia. The X-ray was done immediately, and thankfully the results were negative. I was also given the invoice beforehand, which I found helpful.

I’m not sure if this is typical for a routine checkup, but the total cost was about $400 (with the X-ray itself costing $185). Sharing these details in case it helps others understand the pricing at this animal hospital.

The tech was very nice and good with my cat. The vet was also very nice and understanding and patient, even when my cat hissed and was upset. The clinic is clean and affordable as well. Definitely making Dr. Kim my primary vet and sticking to ABH for my pet's needs.

I walked in to inquire about services for our newly diagnosed hyperthyroid cat and the receptionist was informative, compassionate and offered an appointment for the next day. I was impressed with the cleanliness and brightness of the large space.

Things only got better from there. The appointment with Dr. Popp began with information gathering and quick exam by technician Ivan. Very personable and obviously competent. Was able to perform an oral exam that previous new vet “deferred due to patient personality”. Dr. Popp was very friendly/relatable, thorough and concerned. She also performed other elements of exam (ex, obtaining urine specimen) that other vet also deferred. At every step, I was made aware of what the (yeah, kind of high) charges were going to be.

What was also awesome is that they ran bloodwork on site and results were immediately available so we could make treatment decisions right away.

I highly recommend BAH and have already recommended them to friends who have since made appointments. You should too.

Dr Perry and the team are always helpful and knowledgeable. The team also takes the time to explain what’s going on with my dog and let me ask a million questions. I always receive a follow up post visit and appointments are easy to get.
Thanks for the review, Richa! Our team appreciates it.

After over three years of trying to help my little girl, Lydia, we finally had to say goodbye and put her to sleep. It was incredibly hard but Dr Dupre and Matty were amazing for us. They were so kind and so compassionate. I genuinely dont think we could have gotten through it without them. Dr Dupre did such an amazing job of reassuring us and acknowledging how hard we tried and there was nothing more to do. Through the whole ordeal we went with Broadway and wouldn't have changed a thing. Thank you Dr Dupre and thank you Matty. To those reading this, please keep Lydia in your hearts, she was a great kitty, and I'll miss her forever. Here is a picture of Lydia.

NOPE NOPE NOPE!!!!! Terrible, TERRIBLE place with awful price gouging tactics and ridiculously predatory behaviors towards pet owners. Where do I even begin.

I’ve started going to Broadway Animal Hospital this summer after relocating from Gold Coast to Edgewater with my two senior registered ESA cats. I’ve been my babies’ sole owner for close to five years now and initially went in for their annual visit (which already was ~$150 per cat) & later, the bloodwork/urinalysis for one of them (since the other got theirs done in GC).

After paying the $400 for bloodwork & urinalysis, the vet informed me of issues with him he saw, citing hyperthyroidism and crystals in his urine. My cat displays NO symptoms so that was already confusing to hear. To my relief, they responded and said both of those diagnosed were inaccurate to his actual health, saying “Sometimes when we send samples to the lab (which we did in his case) the can produce crystals if sitting for too long as an artifact” and to come in for a recheck. Now usually, when the service you pay for is not done correctly the first time, the correct response is to either refund the initial service, or provide the follow up for free, HOWEVER these people tried to get me to pay ANOTHER  ~$150 in retesting his urine when it was their fault/their lab’s fault it was done incorrectly the first time. P.S. there weren’t any crystals on the 2nd test and he’s healthy.

Obviously, I refused to pay for the extra urinalysis test and they ended up waiving the $150. They said that “Things cost money” and that their prices were so high because of the “quality” and “new” technology they use. If your technology is so new and great, why would you give me TWO INCORRECT DIAGNOSES and waste my time, energy, and money in the process? I was sick to my stomach thinking of how my baby somehow rapidly got this unhealthy - I felt ashamed of myself for not catching it, and was worried I would be paying an extra $200 in lifestyle changes per month when that wasn’t the case whatsoever. In total, I’ve spent $700 with this place to be told virtually NOTHING HELPFUL and be provided terrible service every time.

They also told me he would need a teeth cleaning, quoting me a grand total of $1700 MINIMUM including all labs & procedure stuff. I called my vet in the suburbs, asking for the same procedure, and they quoted me ONLY $450.

Oh by the way, you better not go in a time crunch! Each appointment I was waiting for over 20-30+ minutes before the doctor attended my scheduled appointment time.

Never, ever coming back here again. The convenience is not worth it. The one good thing about this place is their desk workers, they deserve a raise for dealing with this management.

the care, concern, and personal touch here exceeds any vet I've been to. they know my cats name, they know her history. the facilities are professional and clean.

the location is very good. their use of technology makes scheduling a breeze, and automate confirmation reminders are a big part of that. when I've expressed concerns about cost, I don't feel guilted by them, which helps encourage me to take action (sometimes guilt can lead to procrastination).

highly recommend to anyone close to the edgewater neighborhood and beyond

They also included some toothpaste, rinse, treats and even a toothbrush for me to help brush her teeth every day! I always get notifications about her health and what vaccines she needs annually. The staff, literally everyone I have ever encountered, from the front desk to the techs, to the doctors, are so kind and do everything they can for you. My dog has seen a few of the doctors now due to some emergency visits and they are all amazing. I could hear them from the exam room cheering her on while she received fluids. Knowing that she is being well taken care of when she is sick (and I am anxious because of it) just takes such a weight off. My dog is also dog reactive and they always make sure the lobby is clear for me to come in, which is so helpful. I could not recommend this place enough, truly. Thank you to all of the staff here that have cared for autumn. You are all rockstars.
